analyst_case: 1 kPa transverse pressure on isolated fixed-base/free-tip post, 32 in tributary width. Not a site wind code selection.

channel_gross_section.limits: Gross elastic section only; holes, weld transfer, local web bending, prying/contact, buckling and fatigue not passed. A single assumed effective-width plate-strip calculation is not a stiffness/contact solution.

connection_demands.interpretation: Distinct ideal rigid groups. Negative reaction requires compression/contact, not negative bolt tension. Actual prying/contact/stiffness, local web bending and perimeter-rail torsion are not passed.

mass_limits: Partial member/panel nominal budget only, using catalog where provided and nominal CAD density otherwise. Excludes bought hardware, many body attachments, liners/insulation, complete seats, trucks, brakes, HVAC and service equipment. Not coach tare.
critical_unfinished: All J01 local HSS wall/contact/bolt/preload/weld/fatigue and global load paths
Roof strength, roof/end wall/purlin/skin/liner/insulation attachments and weathering
Bench/floor actual hardpoint collision and seat construction
Truck / wheel / axle / suspension / brake actual interfaces
Normal boarding side, stair/platform and emergency evacuation geometry
